# P1 · Front desk and appointments MVP — R1 · Front Desk

**Window:** Weeks 4–10 · 16 Nov 2026 → 01 Jan 2027  
**Delivered to:** Receptionists, doctors (schedule view) and owners at 2 design-partner clinics  
**Day one:** Register patients, book, reschedule and cancel appointments, check patients in, run the waiting room and send automatic confirmations and reminders.  
**Goal:** A clinic can run its entire appointment day in Medvya. This is the workflow to validate with real clinics before anything clinical is built on top.

**Tickets:** 46 · **Estimate:** 86.5 dev-days vs **35 working days** in the window (OVER by 51.5 days: needs scope trade-off or overlap) · **Average confidence:** 81%

**Status:** To do 40 · In progress 5 · Done 1

| MDV-P1-E01 | Public site | P1-01 | Landing, region/residency selector, trust centre and demo request on the Razor public site. |

## Exit criteria (release gate)

- [ ] Both clinics run 2 consecutive weeks of real bookings without paper fallback — [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)
- [ ] 0 double bookings with 100 parallel attempts on one slot — [MDV-P1-022](MDV-P1-022.md), [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)
- [ ] Median check-in ≤ 60 s for a returning patient — [MDV-P1-028](MDV-P1-028.md), [MDV-P1-041](MDV-P1-041.md), [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)
- [ ] ≥ 98% reminders delivered; failures visible to reception — [MDV-P1-032](MDV-P1-032.md), [MDV-P1-033](MDV-P1-033.md), [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)
- [ ] No open high or critical security findings — [MDV-P1-038](MDV-P1-038.md), [MDV-P1-042](MDV-P1-042.md)

**Not in this phase:** Clinical notes, prescriptions, billing, AI, patient portal.
